business_problem: Carrefour needed a modern infrastructure to meet EU e-invoicing regulations, deliver receipts instantly, and centralize data for analytics and AI-readiness across multiple regions.
solution_summary: Carrefour needed a modern infrastructure to meet EU e-invoicing regulations, deliver receipts instantly, and centralize data for analytics and AI-readiness across multiple regions. By adopting MongoDB Atlas on Google Cloud, Carrefour built a real-time operational data store with simplified management, high scalability, and seamless cloud-native integration. This is particularly relevant now that European regulatory constraints, collectively known as EURINV19, require customers to have automatic access to electronic invoices. Aimed at helping businesses and public entities adopt and comply with the European standard for electronic invoicing, EURINV19 facilitates seamless, cross-border e-invoicing within the EU. With an increasing volume of receipt data and strict invoicing compliance requirements, the retailer needed a more responsive and flexible backend system.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
solution_components.role: Retrieves semantically relevant context from Carrefour's data for AI, search, and recommendation workflows.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the high-volume operational and event data that underpins Carrefour's real-time analytics platform.

data_flow: Business documents, tickets, records, and other operational content stay in MongoDB Atlas Vector Search and MongoDB Atlas, where search indexes or vector embeddings are built and then queried in real time to supply grounded results to applications, assistants, or discovery features. Upstream and downstream integrations include AWS, Google Cloud, APIs.
business_outcome: Receipts delivered in milliseconds Real-time dashboards for managers Infrastructure ready for generative AI
architecture_clues: Vector search is part of the retrieval layer for semantic or generative-AI use cases.
The deployment integrates with Google Cloud.
